knowledge:
- key_parameters: flip=logical value in TSCANorder to reverse the direction of the pseudotemporal ordering ;; orderonly=logical value in TSCANorder; if FALSE, returns a data frame containing cell names, pseudotime values, and state/cluster assignments instead of just ordered cell names ;; MST_or_marker_genes=optional vector in TSCANorder to guide or tune the starting point of the path using marker gene expression or cluster indices
- alternatives: SPADE=uses unsupervised spanning-tree progression for flow cytometry data ;; Monocle=uses unsupervised minimum spanning tree to order whole-transcriptome profiles along pseudotime
- when_to_use: Use when analyzing single-cell RNA-seq data to reconstruct differentiation lineages, order individual cells along a continuous biological process (pseudotime), and identify genes whose expression changes significantly along the trajectory.
- pitfalls: Unsupervised trajectory algorithms (like MST or TSP) cannot automatically determine the true biological starting or ending points, which can lead to reversed trajectories. Users should incorporate prior biological knowledge (marker genes) to correctly orient the path. Additionally, the default preprocessing step filters out genes with low expression or low coefficient of covariance, which may be too stringent for some datasets.

workflows.name: single_cell_trajectory_analysis
workflows.intent: Reconstruct single-cell differentiation trajectories, order cells along pseudotime, and identify differentially expressed genes along the path.
input: lpsdata.ext (matrix or data frame of raw single-cell gene expression values, with genes as rows and cells as columns)
workflows.stages: 1. Preprocess raw expression data to filter out low-expressed and low-variance genes using preprocess ;; 2. Perform dimension reduction and model-based clustering using exprmclust ;; 3. Visualize the clustering results using plotmclust ;; 4. Construct the pseudotemporal cell ordering using TSCANorder ;; 5. Test for differentially expressed genes along the pseudotime trajectory using difftest ;; 6. Plot expression of individual genes against pseudotime using singlegeneplot ;; 7. Evaluate and compare different pseudotemporal orderings using orderscore
workflows.code:
library(TSCAN)
data(lpsdata)
procdata <- preprocess(lpsdata)

lpsmclust <- exprmclust(procdata)

plotmclust(lpsmclust)

lpsorder <- TSCANorder(lpsmclust)
lpsorder

diffval <- difftest(procdata,lpsorder)
#Selected differentially expressed genes under qvlue cutoff of 0.05
head(row.names(diffval)[diffval$qval < 0.05])

STAT2expr <- log2(lpsdata["STAT2",]+1)
singlegeneplot(STAT2expr, TSCANorder(lpsmclust,flip=TRUE,orderonly=FALSE))

subpopulation <- data.frame(cell = colnames(procdata), sub = ifelse(grepl("Unstimulated",colnames(procdata)),0,1), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
#Comparing ordering with or without marker gene information
order1 <- TSCANorder(lpsmclust)
order2 <- TSCANorder(lpsmclust, c(1,2,3))
orders <- list(order1,order2)

orderscore(subpopulation, orders)
